name: Log drum (penv bounce)
desc: The signature amapiano log drum: a saturated sawtooth with a downward penv glide on every hit, bouncing between octaves (d2<->d3) through a syncopated Dm-Dm-Bb-C walk. Punchy midbass with a resonant ring the way the log drum actually sits. Sparse leaves air between the boings; full is the interlocking bounce with a 16-cycle filter tide and phrase-end ply fills; peak busies the roll and hangs an octave-up ghost canon over it.

glide.doc: penv glide depth in semitones (the log-drum boing)

cut.doc: lpf center Hz (lets the woody harmonics through)

drive.doc: shape saturation for woody log-drum body

code.full: note("<[d2 ~ ~ d3 ~ d2 ~ d3 d2 ~ ~ a2 ~ f2 ~ ~] [d2 ~ ~ d3 ~ d2 ~ d3 d2 ~ ~ a2 ~ c3 ~ ~] [bb2 ~ ~ bb3 ~ bb2 ~ bb3 bb2 ~ ~ f2 ~ d2 ~ ~] [c3 ~ ~ c2 ~ c3 ~ c2 c3 ~ ~ g2 ~ a2 ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").penv(${glide}).pdec(.09).attack(.002).decay(.5).sustain(.15).release(.22).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(3).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(.12).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[d2 ~ d3 d2 ~ d2 d3 d2 d3 ~ d2 a2 ~ f2 d3 c3] [d2 ~ d3 d2 ~ d2 d3 d2 d3 ~ d2 a2 ~ c3 d3 e3] [bb2 ~ bb3 bb2 ~ bb2 bb3 bb2 bb3 ~ bb2 f2 ~ d2 bb2 c3] [c3 ~ c2 c3 ~ c3 c2 c3 c2 ~ c3 g2 ~ a2 c3 d3]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").penv(${glide}).pdec(.08).attack(.002).decay(.42).sustain(.12).release(.18).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.7).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.4)).orbit(3).play()
